v.en: O God, come to my assistance;

r.en: O Lord, make haste to help me.

source.scope: Psalmi & antiphonæ ex Proprio de Tempore

text.la: Cánite tuba * in Sion, quia prope est dies Dómini: ecce véniet ad salvándum nos, allelúia, allelúia.
text.en: Blow ye the trumpet * in Zion, for the day of the Lord is nigh at hand: behold, He cometh to save us! Alleluia, Alleluia.

text.la: Ecce véniet * desiderátus cunctis géntibus: et replébitur glória domus Dómini, allelúia.
text.en: Behold, the desire * of all nations shall come; and the house of the Lord shall be filled with glory. Alleluia.

text.la: Erunt prava * in dirécta, et áspera in vias planas: veni, Dómine, et noli tardáre, allelúia.
text.en: The crooked * shall be made straight, and the rough places plain; O Lord, come, and make no tarrying. Alleluia.

text.la: Dóminus véniet, * occúrrite illi, dicéntes: Magnum princípium, et regni eius non erit finis: Deus, Fortis, Dominátor, Princeps pacis, allelúia, allelúia.
text.en: The Lord cometh! * Go ye out to meet Him, and say: How great is His dominion, and of His kingdom there shall be no end! He is the mighty God, the Ruler, the Prince of Peace. Alleluia, Alleluia.

text.la: Omnípotens Sermo tuus, * Dómine, a regálibus sédibus véniet, allelúia.
text.en: Thine Almighty Word, * O Lord, shall leap down out of thy royal throne. Alleluia.

text.la: Fratres: Sic nos exístimet homo ut minístros Christi, et dispensatóres mysteriórum Dei. Hic iam quǽritur inter dispensatóres, ut fidélis quis inveniátur.
text.en: Brothers: Let a man so account of us as of the ministers of Christ, and the dispensers of the mysteries of God. Here now it is required among the dispensers, that a man be found faithful.

v.la: Vox clamántis in desérto: Paráte viam Dómini.
v.en: A voice of one crying in the wilderness: Prepare the way of the Lord.

text.la: Ave, María, * grátia plena: Dóminus tecum: benedícta tu in muliéribus, allelúia.
text.en: Hail, Mary, full of grace, * the Lord is with thee; blessed art thou among women. Alleluia.

text.la: Excita, quǽsumus, Dómine, poténtiam tuam, et veni: et magna nobis virtúte succúrre; ut per auxílium grátiæ tuæ, quod nostra peccáta præpédiunt, indulgéntia tuæ propitiatiónis accéleret:
text.en: Stir up, we beseech thee, O Lord, thy power, and come; make haste to our aid with thy great might; that, by the help of thy grace, that which is hindered by our sins may be hastened by thy merciful forgiveness.
